text: We are a committee of fifty, and we have been employed to collect the Cornish language. In that operation we have gained a great deal, but our net is of too small a mesh to let nothing pass, and so we present you from time to time with a little of what we gather. Of course, we do not pretend to say that our instrument will gather everything, but we hope to be able to tell you of nothing that passes it.
